prompts:
The ferry company's boarding screens play a short recorded announcement. The next one is this sentence:

"Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."

Deliver it as spoken audio in `./announcement.wav`, a WAV file of 4 to 8 seconds that a passenger can understand.
diff:
A checkwav.ps1
A tts.ps1

--- checkwav.ps1 ---
$path = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'announcement.wav'
$b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
$pos = 12
while ($pos + 8 -le $b.Length) {
  $id = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($b, $pos, 4)
  $size = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($b, $pos + 4)
  if ($id -eq 'fmt ') {
    $rate = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($b, $pos + 12)
    $ch = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($b, $pos + 10)
    $bits = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($b, $pos + 22)
  }
  if ($id -eq 'data') {
    $dur = $size / ($rate * $ch * ($bits / 8))
    Write-Output ("data_bytes={0} duration_seconds={1:N2} rate={2} ch={3} bits={4}" -f $size, $dur, $rate, $ch, $bits)
  }
  $pos += 8 + $size + ($size % 2)
}

--- tts.ps1 ---
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$synth = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
try { $synth.SelectVoice('Microsoft Zira Desktop') } catch { }
$synth.Rate = -1
$out = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'announcement.wav'
$synth.SetOutputToWaveFile($out)
$synth.Speak('Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors.')
$synth.Dispose()
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($out)
# WAV: bytes 24-27 sample rate, data chunk size at offset 40 for canonical header
$sampleRate = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, 24)
$dataSize = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, 40)
$channels = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, 22)
$bits = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, 34)
$duration = $dataSize / ($sampleRate * $channels * ($bits / 8))
Write-Output ("duration_seconds={0:N2} rate={1} channels={2} bits={3} bytes={4}" -f $duration, $sampleRate, $channels, $bits, $bytes.Length)
